messages:
jordan_w: Heads up — prod latency dashboard (service/api) lost the tail lines after the 03:10 deploy. p95 and p99 series gone, p50/p90 still there. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
maya: I can confirm from my side. Panel looks flat, only median and p90 showing. Can you paste the panel query?
jordan_w: Query in Grafana is `rate(service_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])` + `histogram_quantile(0.95, ...)` etc. Screenshot attached (not included here) — looks like the quantile() calls return 0 series.
liam-r: metrics-bot just posted an ingestion change: "collector: metrics-prefix normalization enabled for canary ns" — maybe related. @metrics-bot any details?
metrics-bot: collector-change: normalized metric name suffixes in canary to remove raw suffixes. rolled config 03:09 UTC. affected metrics: service_latency_seconds_raw -> service_latency_seconds.
maya: Ah, the dashboard queries explicitly reference the old metric name with `_raw` in a PromQL selector on some panels. If the ingester normalized names, that would explain missing series.
jordan_w: But our histogram_quantile uses the bucket series name. If the bucket names changed (service_latency_seconds_bucket_raw -> service_latency_seconds_bucket) panels could miss them.
liam-r: Quick check: `promtool query instant prom 'count({__name__=~"service_latency_seconds_bucket.*"})'` returns 0 for `_raw` suffix, and counts for the normalized name. so yes.
ops-oncall: Workaround: edit the Grafana panel to use regex name `service_latency_seconds_bucket.*` instead of hardcoded `_raw`. That should pick up both old and new until we fully roll the collector.
maya: Agree. Also change dashboard templating to reference bucket base name without suffix, or use `label_replace` to be robust.
jordan_w: Will do a quick patch to the dashboard JSON now and push as a hotfix. Patching panels in place to match both names.
liam-r: I'll open an incident and mark root cause as "collector metric rename during canary normalization". Assign to infra-collector for the rollout plan and to dashboard owners for durable query fixes.
metrics-bot: incident created: #INC-3412 — dashboards/regressions — assign: infra-collector, dash-team.
ops-oncall: After Jordan's hotfix deployed (03:30), I see p95/p99 lines return on prod-panel. Re-checking historical panels, no data loss — just name mismatch.
maya: Confirmed. Closing the urgent p95/p99 alert. We should update the rollout checklist to include dashboard compatibility when renaming metric families.
jordan_w: PR #4512 open to make queries resilient and add note in collector CHANGELOG.
liam-r: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: infra-collector to coordinate a migration window for metric renames; dashboards to prefer regex or metric aliasing; oncall to monitor for 1h.
ops-oncall: :thumbsup: closing thread in 1h unless new regressions crop up.
